value.description: The controlled value of the input

default-value.description:
The initial value of the input when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the value of the input.

min.description: The minimum value of the number input

max.description: The maximum value of the number input

step.description: The amount to increment or decrement the value by

large-step.description: The amount to increment or decrement the value by when the `Shift` key is held.

small-step.description: The amount to increment or decrement the value by when the `Alt` key is held.

format-options.description: The options to pass to the `Intl.NumberFormat` constructor

locale.description: The current locale. Based on the BCP 47 definition.

input-mode.description:
Hints at the type of data that might be entered by the user. It also determines
the type of keyboard shown to the user on mobile devices

pattern.description: The pattern used to check the <input> element's value against

allow-mouse-wheel.description: Whether to allow mouse wheel to change the value

focus-input-on-change.description: Whether to focus input when the value changes

spin-on-press.description: Whether to spin the value when the increment/decrement button is pressed

disabled.description: Whether the number input is disabled.

invalid.description: Whether the number input value is invalid.

required.description: Whether the number input is required

name.description: The name attribute of the number input. Useful for form submission.

form.description: The associate form of the input element.

as-child.description: Apply the props to the first child element instead of this element.

debug.description: Log state transitions, events and prop changes to the console. Applies to descendants too.

valueinvalid.description: Fired when the value overflows or underflows the min/max range

focuschange.description: Fired when the number input is focused

valuecommit.description: Fired when the value is committed (when the input is blurred or the Enter key is pressed)

ids.type: Partial<{ root: string; label: string; input: string; incrementTrigger: string; decrementTrigger: string; scrubber: string; scrubberCursor: string; hiddenInput: string; }>
ids.description: The ids of the elements in the number input. Useful for composition.

translations.description: Specifies the localized strings that identifies the accessibility elements and their states

value.description: The controlled value. Use `null` for an empty input.

state.description: The root's state from its machine (`getRootState()`), such as `open` or `disabled`. `undefined` until it connects.

ready.description: Resolves once the element's machine has started, so `api`, state and parts are in place.

api.description: The Zag API of the component. `undefined` until it connects.

increment.description: Function to increment the value of the input by the step.

decrement.description: Function to decrement the value of the input by the step.

for.description: The id of the root this part belongs to, when it is not a descendant.
